country: Multinational (31 radiation oncologists at 16 institutions in six countries on five continents)
sample_unit: cases (RPA contours and plans reviewed by at least three physicians each)

links.outcome: Clinician-rated acceptability of AI contours and plans on 5-point Likert scale
links.effect: Head/neck CTVs acceptable as-is in 40% (93% with minor edits); postmastectomy breast plans usable as-is in 44% (91% with minor edits); cervical VMAT plans acceptable as-is in 99%.
links.quote: The clinical target volumes (CTVs) were acceptable as-is in 40% (with minor edits 93%).

screen.reason: Multicenter international reader study evaluating the clinical acceptability and usability of an automated radiation therapy contouring and planning tool (Radiation Planning Assistant) across various cancer types.
